variants.headline: Still in view: home world answers colony's petition
variants.sub: A reply to the colony's petition has come from the home world.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. The home world has answered the colony's petition.

We support {target} in this assessment. Seeking and handling a response deserves a fair hearing; an answer should not become the occasion for hostile conclusions founded on terms this account does not establish.

variants.headline: Still in view: petition receives an answer
variants.sub: The home world has answered the colony's petition.
variants.body:
Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point. The colony has received an answer to its petition from the home world.
